summary: Captured a 3-option comparison deliverable for a note-reply-thread UI on FellowScript's iOS NoteDetailView, grounded in the real NoteDetailView/FSNote source and the existing (partial) reply data model (POST /notes/reply/{note_id}, GroupsManager.fetch_replies, FSNote.replies field) rather than treating replies as greenfield. Flagged forward that personal (non-group) notes have no wired GET-replies endpoint today, only group notes do. Media type hint: static (3 rendered mockups).
